notes.title: Live: Watch me play The Zone
The Zone - About the game
notes.content:
Team
Three people is involved in the development of The Zone game:


 Gabriel Stafoca - Programmer and Game designer
 Raphael Stafoca - Sound Designer and Game designer
 Samuel Teodoro - Art and Game designer


Our team is called Colossus Game Studio. We also have released 2 more games (Rainbow Hunter and Super Rebellion).

History
An unsuccessful experiment was done on an island at URSS was resulted in an unknown chemical element creation.

When the particles with this element enter in contact with electric waves, a portal opens and bring from another dimension strange creatures.

Dimitri was ordered to investigate the local where the experiment was occurred and disable all the electrical installations to avoid that these creatures have multiplies and go out of the island.

Demo content
In the demo, you will can play 6 minutes of the game. But it is a Alpha v 0.1.2, so some bugs still can be there. 

Release and Development
The Zone are in development since December 2019. The engine used was Unity.
The Zone will be released in June 26th.

For more content about our game, please let us know.

We hope you enjoy the game. 

Thank you!
Colossus Game Studio Team.
